name: Northern Trust
description: Northern Trust is a custody and wealth-management bank. Asset Servicing holds and administers $17.4 trillion of assets for institutions and charges fees on them (2.8 billion of trust, investment and servicing fees), while Wealth Management serves wealthy families and individuals with banking, trust and advice on $507 billion of AUM and earns fees plus net interest on average loans of $35 billion. Wealth Management produced more pre-tax income (1.3 billion) than the larger Asset Servicing (1.1 billion) in 2025. Fees were 5.7 billion of 8.1 billion revenue and net interest income 2.4 billion.

employees.note: Approximately 23,800 full-time equivalent employees; 42 percent Asia-Pacific, 41 percent North America (10-K).

businessLines.name: Asset Servicing
businessLines.how: Institutional clients (pension funds, asset managers, sovereigns) pay fees on assets held and administered (trust, investment and other servicing fees 2,800.2), FX trading (268.0) and the bank earns net interest on clients' deposits (1,398.3).

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), income before income taxes (FTE)

businessLines.name: Wealth Management
businessLines.how: Wealthy individuals, families and privately held businesses pay asset-based advisory and trust fees (2,217.6) and net interest on private-banking loans and deposits (1,042.5); revenue follows markets and client assets.

geography.method: Regional revenue tagged in the filing's own XBRL instance: full-year contexts with one geographic dimension (or segments named after places), alone or crossed only with operating segments or a revenue line of the income statement; regions must add up to the revenue line within 1 percent; a member equal to the sum of others is a subtotal; the main split is the largest set of members adding up to the total; anything not broken out is a computed remainder.
